---
title: "wrapped fixture: LaTeX options and lengths"
filters:
  - wrapped
format:
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
classoption: twocolumn=false
wrapped:
  width: 50vw
---

## A metadata width that LaTeX cannot use

![A figure that takes the built-in default width.](plot.png){#fig-meta-vw .wrap-right}

`classoption: twocolumn=false` keeps one column, so the figure wraps. The metadata width `50vw` has no LaTeX length, so the figure takes the built-in default, 40%, and the render prints a warning. ## A wrap-lines value that is not a whole number

![A figure with wrap-lines="banana" and a very small gap.](plot.png){#fig-bad-lines .wrap-left width="30%" wrap-lines="banana" wrap-gap="0.001%"}

The figure takes no line count, and the render prints a warning. The gap is written as a decimal with no exponent. See @fig-bad-lines. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.
